Changelog

Kite 0.2.0 expands the CLI from project and clean-feature scaffolding into a composable generator for architectures, components, state, and networking.

0.2.0

Feature-first MVCTemplate requirementsComponentsRiverpodDio
  • Added feature.mvc with models, manual Riverpod controllers, providers, views, routes, and optional JSON serialization.
  • Added component.button, component.card, and component.avatar.
  • Added the internal component.foundation dependency template.
  • Added production Riverpod bootstrap, provider observation, and async notifier guard templates.
  • Added API contracts and a Dio client with token interception, typed decoding, exception mapping, cancellation, and providers.
  • Added recursive requires resolution with cycle detection and target deduplication.
  • Added shorthand normalization for --feat:mvc, --widget, --state, and --api:dio.
  • Added generation tests and static template validation scenarios.

Command highlights

kite --feat:mvc dashboard
kite --widget "[button,card,avatar]"
kite --state riverpod
kite --api:dio

Documentation website edition

  • Added a branded, responsive documentation site with dark and light themes.
  • Added sidebar navigation, generated page table of contents, command palette, full-text search, copyable examples, and mobile navigation.
  • Added dependency-free Node build, validation, and local server scripts.
  • Added GitHub Pages deployment workflow.
